annotations.title: Bitcoin batch risk check (up to 25 addresses)

description: Screens up to 25 Bitcoin addresses in one call: OFAC sanctions, ransomware payment lists, ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering-pattern cases for each, plus a summary of the flagged ones. For counterparty and withdrawal-address due diligence; about 60% cheaper per address than single checks. Price: 3000 sats or US$2.5 (USDC) per call.

addresses.description: 1 to 25 Bitcoin mainnet addresses (bc1..., 1... or 3...); a comma-separated string also works

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.
